dataset.description:
This description concerns the code written to analyse the tabular data of the description ‘Mapping Research Data at the University of Bologna: Dataset’. We chose R in the 4.2.2 version. With the tabular data structured within the data collection phase as input, the analysis takes the form of descriptive statistics to investigate these two research questions:
  1. What types of data are produced and managed by researchers at the University of Bologna?
  2. What could be trends of problems and patterns useful to improve the Data Stewardship service?
The outputs of this type of code analysis are graphs of various types, from histograms to sankey diagrams.
keyword: research data management, data stewardship, data management plan, research data, data types

dataset.description:
This is a table containing all information estracted from the analysed DMPs, related to projects coordinated by the University of Bologna. For example: types of research data, their formats, accessibility, the type of project, funding, etc.
Each row of the table corresponds to a data entry, i.e. a minimum unit (i.e., a file) that makes up a dataset described in a DMP. A dataset may have several data entries.
keyword: research data management, open science, data management plan

dataset.preservation_statement:
We anonymized all project information (i.e. acronyms, institutional Departments), which could indirectly lead to the identification of people, from the data to be preserved long term.
We have no problems with the size of the file or its technical specifications for filing, as it is under 100 KB and in an extremely accessible and interoperable format.

dmp.description:
This data management plan (DMP) describes the process of planning, handling and depositing research data during a study carried out by the data stewards at the University of Bologna. The study itself is based on a number of DMPs produced by grantees of Horizon Europe and Horizon 2020 funding who are affiliated to the University of Bologna, are either project coordinators or partners in charge of the DMP and have shared their DMP with the data stewards between May 2022 (when the team was first created) and October 2023. The analysis focuses on research data generated and managed within the institution, with respect to the differences and commonalities between disciplines and potential challenges for institutional data support services and infrastructures. 
The data stewards (from now on: we, the authors) are primarily mapping the type, content and format of managed data, thus sustaining the value of FAIR data as granular resources. In short, we have selected 23 variables of interest to be headers of a table that is progressively filled with information garnered through a close reading of the DMPs. Computational analysis (R version 4.2.2) on the collected data produces graphs showing composition and relationship (e.g., bar graphs, sankey charts) of the different variables. The data and the script used for analysis are published openly.
dmp.title: Mapping research data at the University of Bologna: Data Management Plan
